group_map.caption: Example group analysis of 54 participant gain-effect maps (run 09). Colors show unthresholded t statistics within common participant coverage; yellow outlines the anatomical vmPFC region and green shows positive whole-brain FWE significance. Corrected positive effects were posterior, with no overlap in this vmPFC region.
group_map.result: For run09, 24 positive whole-brain voxels survived permutation max-T FWE correction, with none in bilateral medial orbitofrontal vmPFC parcels. The descriptive mean gain coefficient in that region was -0.00793 (95% t CI -0.03462 to 0.01877). This bounded group reanalysis does not reproduce all upstream NARPS processing or a precision-weighted mixed-effects model.
group_map.interpretation: The example does not support the specified positive vmPFC hypothesis under this run's anatomical definition and whole-brain correction. Absence of significance is not evidence of a zero effect. Gray anatomical areas outside common coverage are not evaluated as null signal.

pilot_variability.caption: Pilot outputs illustrate analysis variation. Run labels identify eight completed analyses; search masks ranged from 186,192 to 210,968 voxels. Native primary correction yielded 11 positive whole-brain voxels with Bonferroni or 24 with permutation max-T. The explicit-STAMPED condition has no completed result in these example inputs.
pilot_variability.interpretation: These are native worker result descriptors. Mask definitions, corrected search spaces and methods differ, so neither condition means nor causal effects are estimated. Incomplete results are absent, not zero. This example should be secondary to the planned finished-study comparison.

existing_runs_do_not_need_to_be_reexecut: Extract each saved native analysis mask, mean-effect map, t map, corrected p map, and corrected positive support, retaining source revision, correction method and hypothesis decision.

Define a fixed evaluation mask before inspecting condition labels: intersection of valid participant support and an independently defined anatomical brain mask, with a fixed vmPFC region for localization.

On that common evaluation mask, compare saved worker t/effect fields and native corrected support using pairwise spatial agreement, voxel counts and overlap; retain native search-space information because it affects correction.
Report failed or incomplete runs separately, preserve every run, and keep an explicit denominator for each condition and skill iteration.
minimum_derived_collection.avoid_as_condition_variability_endpoint: A fixed-ROI mean recomputed from the same 54 source maps is identical across conditions by construction. It is a scientific reference and a correctness check, not an informative skill-condition effect measure.
minimum_derived_collection.requires_prospective_design_change: For a causal assistance-condition claim, freeze skills and the evaluator within each iteration, predefine replicate allocation and stopping, run balanced independent workers for all four conditions, and do not adapt a skill snapshot mid-block. Label derived pilot endpoints as exploratory; use a held-out study or later iteration to evaluate skills adapted from pilot outcomes.
